digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (orchestrator, det_floor.py, passes.py, criteria_routing.json, review_kernel)
propositions: Seven recommendations (R1–R7) from task-decomposition SOTA research must integrate into the plan-review gate with each gated by its own falsifiable experimental threshold or deterministic compliance criterion.

R1/R3/R4 were re-planned to ship in advisory posture (never blocking) with bounded sanity checks and standing dogfood monitoring via d8a5's effectiveness recorder, rather than pre-ship batch evals (operator-approved cost decision).

E1's finding-adjudication and inter-rater kappa corpus were invalidated (tool-less/plan-truncated labeling ~79% contaminated) and descoped; only the outcome corpus (628 rows) was frozen and committed.

E2/E3 LLM batch baselines were permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5's zero-LLM standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py), replacing expensive counterfactual replay with production dogfooding.

Validated changes land directly in packaged criteria_routing.json and review_kernel with no config-flag or overlay gating; advisory→blocking promotion is gated on accumulated dogfood evidence (blocking-FP proxy ≤10%).
R6 ships deterministic (no eval gate); R5's IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump is coordinated with floor-split story to avoid file conflicts; R7 instrumentation deploys before any detection changes.
